contract.name: Winter 2026/27 travel agent contracted rates – Premium Hotels (revised)
contract.hotel_reference: Premium Hotels – Travel Agent Contracted Rates – Winter 2026-2027 (Revised)
contract.tax_note: USD nett, non-commissionable. In case of an increase in taxes or any additional taxes the hotel may add them from the date of implementation.
contract.guide_policy_text: Driver Accommodation – Not Available. The Guide/Tour leader policy on the terms page is only applicable at Jetwing Blue / Beach / Sea / Lake / St. Andrew's — no guide rate for this hotel.
contract.cancellation_text: Cancellations within 07 days of the arrival date – 100% of the value of the booking. Cancellations within 14 days of the arrival date – 50% of the value of the booking. Cancellations within 21 days of the arrival date – 25% of the value of the booking. Group bookings, more than 8 rooms, will be liable to pay 50% of the basis booked before 30 days of arrival.
contract.payment_text: Travel agents without credit facilities are required to make the relevant payment 05 days before the clients check into the hotel. Travel agents that are entitled to credit facilities should make necessary payments within one month of the departure of guests. For last minute/short notice bookings, 100% of the payment is to be made on confirmation.
contract.terms_text: JETWING RATNAM RESIDENCE (Colombo): Currency USD nett (Per room/Per night); Period 01st November 2026 – 30th April 2027; Room Only Basis: Deluxe (Double Occupancy) (03 Rooms) USD 50; Deluxe Attic (Quadruple Occupancy) (01 Room) USD 70; Whole Villa (Maximum 08 Pax) USD 200. No single reduction, triple supplement, child policy, offer or value addition printed. Driver Accommodation – Not Available. Reservations +94 114 709 400, resv.villas@jetwinghotels.com. | RATES: Rates are in USD and are non-commissionable. The accommodation rates are not valid for Meetings/Incentives/Conferences/Events/Exhibitions/Weddings. In case of an increase in taxes or any additional taxes, the hotel reserves the right to add such taxes to the rates from the date of implementation. Rates cannot be extended to the domestic market or any other unspecified markets. Rates should not be published as hotel only rate on the internet by you or any other 3rd party. If such case occurs, the hotel has the right to withdraw the rate with immediate effect. | VALUE ADDITIONS POLICY: A maximum of 03 value adds can be used at each property. Experiences like Tours/Walks/Demonstrations etc. will be arranged in common groups depending on the occupancy for the day. Meal upgrade offers are valid only for FIT bookings. Food & Beverage discounts are not combinable with other promotions, offers, vouchers, outlets or seasonal deals. Food & Beverage discounts will not be applicable for liquor & tobacco. | CHECK-IN/CHECK-OUT: Check-in time is 14:00 and check-out time is 12:00 (noon). If an early check-in is required within 04 hours of the usual check-in time, 50% charge of the room rate will be applied. For late check-outs up to 04 hours past the original check-out time, a 50% room rate charge will apply. Late check outs past 04 hours will be charged for 100% room rate.
contract.notes: Transcribed from "Jetwing Premium Hotels - TA Contracted Rates - Winter 2026-2027 (Revised).pdf" (20 pages), saved to the winter RTS folder on 2 Oct 2026. One period (01 Nov 2026 – 30 Apr 2027), Room Only, USD nett per room per night. The page prints no "Occupancy" line, no single/triple terms, no child policy and no offers. Market clause from the terms page → DOM excluded. No contract date, gala dinner or rate code printed. No supplier record in the live system yet (acc None) — needs a supplier record before it can be saved. Deluxe Attic is printed only at "Quadruple Occupancy" (USD 70 per room) → entered in the QUAD column only; the price for 1–3 occupants is not printed (confirm). The Whole Villa (maximum 08 pax, USD 200 per villa per night, room only) is in the separate per-unit plan rts_jwp_ratnam_villa.
